articles.title: School Bus Crash in Mandya Injures 22, Separate KSRTC Bus Fire Sparks Safety Concerns #breakingnews
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A road accident involving a school vehicle and a private bus left 22 people injured, including 14 students, near Adigas Hotel on Somanahalli–Kesturu Cross Road in Mandya on Friday evening. According to officials, the injured students belong to Dr. Shantha H.K.

body.html:
A road accident involving a school vehicle and a private bus left 22 people injured, including 14 students, near Adigas Hotel on Somanahalli–Kesturu Cross Road in Mandya on Friday evening.

According to officials, the injured students belong to Dr. Shantha H.K. Mariyappa Educational Institution in Maddur. The collision occurred when a private Udayaranga bus reportedly rammed into the school vehicle as students were returning to their villages after school hours.

Among the injured are Sushilamma, Gouramma, Shivaram, Shobha and Shivamallu, who were travelling in the private bus. All injured were shifted to a taluk hospital for treatment, while six persons, including two students, were referred to Mandya MIMS Hospital for further care.

The students, hailing from Kadalipur, Hulaganahalli and Hemmanahalli villages, were on their way home when the accident took place. Following the incident, anxious parents rushed to the hospital to check on their children.

Several officials, including former minister D. C. Thammanna, the Deputy Commissioner, Superintendent of Police, and other district authorities visited the hospital and enquired about the condition of the injured.

A case has been registered at Maddur Traffic Police Station, and further investigation is underway.

In a separate incident raising fresh safety concerns, a Karnataka State Road Transport Corporation bus travelling from Bengaluru to Shivamogga caught fire late Thursday night near Lulu Mall. The driver noticed flames from the lower section of the bus and immediately evacuated all passengers.

The fire quickly engulfed the vehicle, which was completely gutted before fire personnel brought the blaze under control. No casualties were reported in the incident.

Authorities are expected to review safety protocols amid rising incidents involving public and private transport.

articles.title: “Terrorist” Remark Row: PES University Professor Suspended After Alleged Abuse of Muslim Student
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A professor at PES University, Bengaluru, has come under serious allegations of making derogatory and communal remarks against a Muslim student during a classroom session, triggering widespread outrage. According to reports, Dr.

body.html:
A professor at PES University, Bengaluru, has come under serious allegations of making derogatory and communal remarks against a Muslim student during a classroom session, triggering widespread outrage.

According to reports, Dr. Muralidhar Deshpande allegedly referred to a student, identified as Affan, as a “terrorist” multiple times and subjected him to verbal abuse in front of nearly 60 students, creating a hostile environment.

Witnesses claim the professor also made controversial remarks such as linking the Iran conflict to “people like you,” stating “Trump will take you away,” and calling students “idiots” who would “go to hell.”

In a concerning development, CCTV footage from the classroom—considered crucial evidence—was reportedly deleted, raising questions about transparency and accountability within the institution.

Students who supported the victim allegedly faced disciplinary action, with the administration citing “talking during class” as grounds for suspension.

While the professor is said to have submitted a written apology to the institution, no direct apology has reportedly been made to the student. The department head has apologised on his behalf but is also accused of indirectly pressuring the student with statements suggesting institutional influence over media and advising him to “think about his career.”

The incident has reportedly caused significant distress to the student, who, instead of receiving support, allegedly faced continued pressure and isolation.

Meanwhile, a police complaint has been filed by the National Students' Union of India against the professor over the alleged incident.

Following the controversy, the university has suspended Dr. Deshpande. However, the administration is yet to release a detailed public statement on the matter.

articles.title: Love Affair Turns Deadly: Woman Cop Poisoned Father, Truth Exposed After 3 Years by Husband
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A sensational murder case has been solved in Chandrapur, where a three-year-old death of a police officer has now been revealed as a planned murder. The case has shocked the entire district after it emerged that the victim’s own daughter, a police constable, was behind the crime.

body.html:
A sensational murder case has been solved in Chandrapur, where a three-year-old death of a police officer has now been revealed as a planned murder. The case has shocked the entire district after it emerged that the victim’s own daughter, a police constable, was behind the crime.

According to police, Arya Ballawar allegedly poisoned her father, Jayant Ballawar, who was also in the police department, in April 2023. He died while on duty, and at the time, the death did not raise suspicion.

Investigations later revealed that Arya mixed poison in a milkshake given to her father, reportedly because he opposed her love affair. The case came to light after a confession by her husband, Ashish Shedmake, who approached police following ongoing marital disputes.

Police said Arya had procured the poison from her relative, Chaitanya Gedam, for ₹5,000. After Jayant Ballawar’s death, Arya and Ashish got married. However, their relationship deteriorated over time, with frequent arguments. Ashish was also reportedly dismissed from police training due to misconduct.

During one such dispute, Ashish allegedly revealed the entire conspiracy to the police, leading to a major breakthrough in the case. Ironically, the same person for whom the crime was allegedly committed exposed it.

Acting swiftly, Ramnagar police arrested Arya Ballawar, Ashish Shedmake, Chaitanya Gedam, and another accuse involved in supplying the poison. Further investigation is underway to establish all aspects of the conspiracy.

The case has raised serious concerns over abuse of trust and the shocking extent of personal motives leading to violent crimes.

articles.title: “She’s My Wife…” Ignored as Mob Brutally Thrashes Man in Hapur, Video Sparks Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing case of mob violence has surfaced from Hapur, highlighting the growing menace of mobocracy. A young man was allegedly surrounded and brutally beaten by a crowd on the street, even as he repeatedly pleaded, “She’s my wife,” according to a viral video of the incident.

body.html:
A disturbing case of mob violence has surfaced from Hapur, highlighting the growing menace of mobocracy. A young man was allegedly surrounded and brutally beaten by a crowd on the street, even as he repeatedly pleaded, “She’s my wife,” according to a viral video of the incident.

The incident took place in the city police station area, where the man had reportedly gone to his in-laws’ house to take his wife back home. An argument broke out between the couple on the road after the woman refused to go with him, which soon escalated.

During the altercation, the woman allegedly shouted that the man was harassing her. Without verifying facts, bystanders gathered at the spot and quickly turned into an aggressive mob. The युवक was reportedly dragged off his bike, thrown to the ground and assaulted with kicks and punches.

Despite repeatedly clarifying that the woman was his wife and he had come to take her home, the mob allegedly ignored his pleas and continued the assault.

The incident came to light after the video went viral on social media, prompting police to take immediate action. Officials said an investigation has been launched, and efforts are underway to identify those involved using the footage.

Police have assured that strict action will be taken against the accused. The incident has triggered widespread concern, raising serious questions over mob justice, law and order, and the growing tendency of people to take the law into their own hands.

articles.title: “Honoured by Insult?” Chaos Erupts at Jaipur Convocation as Students Protest on Stage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A commotion broke out during the convocation ceremony at Haridev Joshi University of Journalism and Mass Communication in Jaipur after students expressed strong displeasure over the conduct of the programme held at Rajasthan International Centre.

body.html:
A commotion broke out during the convocation ceremony at Haridev Joshi University of Journalism and Mass Communication in Jaipur after students expressed strong displeasure over the conduct of the programme held at Rajasthan International Centre.

The ceremony initially concluded with degrees being awarded on stage to only 12 gold medallists, triggering anger among other students. As the event progressed, several students raised slogans against the university administration, alleging unequal treatment and lack of opportunity for all graduates. Protests were also directed at Vice-Chancellor Nandkishore Pandey.

In a dramatic moment, a student, upon receiving her degree from Deputy Chief Minister Premchand Bairwa, remarked, “Thank you very much for honouring me by insulting me,” leaving the audience stunned.

Following the outburst, Bairwa intervened and personally distributed degrees to the remaining students in an attempt to defuse tensions. Reports suggest the student’s reaction stemmed from dissatisfaction with the administration’s handling of the ceremony.

The incident briefly disrupted proceedings before organisers brought the situation under control and continued the event. The university administration has not issued an official statement so far.

A video of the incident has gone viral on social media, sparking mixed reactions, with some calling the student’s act courageous while others deeming it inappropriate. The episode has since become a subject of widespread debate.

articles.title: Morning Horror in Varanasi: Speeding Car Mows Down Pedestrians, Driver Flees After Crash
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident was reported from Varanasi where a speeding car allegedly ran over pedestrians walking along the roadside near Sajan intersection under Sigra police station around 9:30 am. A video of the incident has surfaced, capturing the entire sequence.

body.html:
A shocking incident was reported from Varanasi where a speeding car allegedly ran over pedestrians walking along the roadside near Sajan intersection under Sigra police station around 9:30 am. A video of the incident has surfaced, capturing the entire sequence.

According to police, the car first hit a youth, who was thrown nearly 5 feet into the air before falling onto the road. The out-of-control vehicle then struck three more pedestrians walking nearby and eventually rammed into a pickup truck from behind.

After the collision, the driver reversed the car and fled the spot, leaving the injured behind.

Police reached the scene promptly and shifted four injured persons to a hospital. The injured have been identified as Sanjay Gupta alias Guddu, son of Amarnath Gupta from Mishri Bazaar, Ghazipur, and Jahur Ansari, son of Razzab Ali from Peer Sagar, along with two others.

Based on CCTV footage, police have launched an intensive search to identify and arrest the absconding driver. A case has been registered on the complaint of the injured, and a team from Kashi Vidyapeeth outpost has been deployed for the investigation.

articles.title: Penthouse Dispute Turns Deadly: Man Rams Car Into Residents in Indore, Woman Killed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dispute over the commercial use of a penthouse in a residential society turned fatal in Indore after a man allegedly rammed his car into a group of residents, killing a woman and injuring several others in Sagar Township under Lasudia police station late Wednesday night.

body.html:
A dispute over the commercial use of a penthouse in a residential society turned fatal in Indore after a man allegedly rammed his car into a group of residents, killing a woman and injuring several others in Sagar Township under Lasudia police station late Wednesday night.

According to police, the accused, Mohit Choudhary, allegedly drove the vehicle into residents during a heated argument. His father, Kuldeep Choudhary, who was also in the car, has been taken into custody along with him.

The deceased has been identified as Shampa Pathak (Pandey), a software engineer. She had recently moved into the flat on March 13 with her husband Saurabh and their two children.

Preliminary investigation suggests the dispute was linked to objections raised by residents over the use of two penthouses for short-term rentals through an online platform. Residents had expressed concerns over frequent movement of outsiders and security issues within the society.

Efforts were made earlier this week to resolve the matter, including intervention by a local councillor, but tensions remained unresolved.

On Wednesday night, the situation escalated, following which the accused allegedly drove the car into the crowd.

Police reached the spot after receiving information and shifted the injured to a private hospital, where doctors declared Pathak dead.

The incident was captured on CCTV cameras installed in the building, and the footage is being examined as part of the investigation.

Additional DCP Amrendra Singh said a case has been registered and statements are being recorded to ascertain the exact sequence of events.

#Indore #BreakingNews #CrimeNews #RoadRage #HousingDispute

articles.title: Kalyan Hit-and-Run: Minor Driving Car Kills Cyclist on Incomplete Ring Road, Mother Also Booked
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A businessman was killed in a hit-and-run incident in Kalyan after a speeding car allegedly driven by a 17 year old boy struck him while he was cycling on an incomplete stretch of the Ring Road on Tuesday night.

body.html:
A businessman was killed in a hit-and-run incident in Kalyan after a speeding car allegedly driven by a 17 year old boy struck him while he was cycling on an incomplete stretch of the Ring Road on Tuesday night.

The victim, identified as Srinivas Tandle (42), was flung into the air on impact. He was rushed to a nearby private hospital by locals but was declared dead on arrival.

According to police, the minor fled the scene immediately after the accident and went into hiding. He was apprehended the following evening. An FIR has been registered under sections related to rash and negligent driving, along with non-bailable charges.

Senior Police Inspector Amarnath Waghmode said the boy’s mother, in whose name the car is registered, has also been named as an accused. The minor reportedly told police that he had informed his mother before taking the vehicle. His father is a lawyer.

Police sources added that the boy had briefly posted on social media after the incident, referring to it as a “small accident” and expressing fear of being scolded by his father. The post was later deleted.

CCTV footage shows that the car, allegedly being driven at high speed, swerved and rammed into Tandle around 8 pm before speeding away. Police later traced the vehicle to a parking lot in the residential building of the accused. The car had minor damage.

Family members said Tandle, who owned multiple garment stores in Kalyan, had recently taken up cycling for fitness and had borrowed a bicycle from a friend just days before the incident.

Locals said the incomplete stretch of the Ring Road is frequently used by walkers and cyclists due to partial closure caused by stalled construction work. Residents alleged that speeding and stunt driving are common on the road, leading to repeated accidents.

Residents and family members have demanded strict action against the accused and urged authorities, and improve safety measures such as speed breakers, CCTV cameras, and barricades.

Police said further investigation is underway.

#Kalyan #Maharashtra #BreakingNews #HitAndRun #RoadSafety

articles.title: Unpaid Wages Spark Rage: Dumper Driver Drags Contractor’s Car in Dombivli, Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Tensions over unpaid wages at a major road construction project in Dombivli West escalated after a dumper driver allegedly damaged a contractor’s car in protest, with the incident captured on video and widely shared on social media.

body.html:
Tensions over unpaid wages at a major road construction project in Dombivli West escalated after a dumper driver allegedly damaged a contractor’s car in protest, with the incident captured on video and widely shared on social media.

The incident occurred in Raju Nagar, where the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority (MMRDA) is executing the Titwala–Mankoli–Motagaon bypass project. Workers engaged in the project have reportedly not been paid for over a month despite repeated demands.

Car Dragged Amid Wage Dispute
According to reports, a dumper driver, frustrated over non-payment of wages, used his loaded vehicle to push and drag the contractor-owner’s car—parked in the middle of the road—for around 10 to 15 feet. The car then rammed into another dumper stationed ahead, sustaining significant damage to both its front and rear.

The driver fled the scene after the incident. No injuries were reported as the vehicle was unoccupied at the time.

Workforce Anger Mounts
Labourers working on the bypass—covering stretches from Aadharwadi-Durgadi to Govindwadi, Khambalpada-Kachore Creek, Ganesh Nagar to Kumbharkhanpada, and Devi-cha-pada to Motagaon—have alleged that wages have been pending for over a month. Workers, many dependent on daily earnings, have been repeatedly demanding payment, leading to growing resentment at the site.

Sources indicate that the delay in payments may be linked to pending dues yet to be cleared by authorities to the contractor.

Police Probe Underway
Vishnunagar Police have taken cognisance of the viral video and launched an investigation into the incident. Officials are examining the circumstances leading to the act and identifying the driver involved.

#Dombivli #Maharashtra #BreakingNews #ViralVideo #LabourIssue

articles.title: Bengaluru Medical College Row: Professor’s ‘Love Claim’ Sparks Campus Chaos, Assault Caught on Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A controversial classroom incident at Sri Siddhartha Institute of Medical Sciences & Research Centre in T. Begur near Nelamangala, Bengaluru Rural, escalated into violence after a professor allegedly made a ‘love proposal’ claim involving a student.

body.html:
A controversial classroom incident at Sri Siddhartha Institute of Medical Sciences & Research Centre in T. Begur near Nelamangala, Bengaluru Rural, escalated into violence after a professor allegedly made a ‘love proposal’ claim involving a student.

The incident, which occurred on Wednesday, came to light after multiple videos recorded by students went viral on social media.

Classroom Incident Triggers Row
According to initial reports, the professor, identified as Mohammed (also referred to as Mohammed Abdul), told students during a class that a student had proposed to him and that he reciprocated her feelings. He was also seen distributing chocolates to the class.

In the video, the student is heard confronting the professor, denying any such proposal and asking him to take the matter to the principal. She questioned his claims, while the professor insisted she had expressed her feelings and even mentioned the existence of CCTV footage. The student demanded that he produce the footage.

The professor then left the classroom, stating he would speak to her the next day.

Situation Turns Violent
Soon after he exited, the situation escalated. The student allegedly assaulted the professor with her slipper, following which other students joined in, leading to a chaotic scene on campus. The professor was reportedly abused and physically attacked.

Police Response
The incident falls under the jurisdiction of Nelamangala Rural Police Station. Police confirmed that they are aware of the videos and have initiated a probe.

However, as of now, no formal complaint has been filed by either the professor or the student.

Authorities are monitoring the situation, and further action will depend on the outcome of the inquiry.

#Bengaluru #Karnataka #BreakingNews #CampusRow #ViralVideo
